chapter: Records, Jimmy Wade and Richard M. Jones
title: Johnny Lindsay, Bill Matthews and others
summary: They discuss the bass player's career and Matthews.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Did you work with him much in Chicago?
No. Just made records, I think.
And Snaggs Jones? Yeah. I guess you didn't work with Johnny Lindsay too much down here either, huh?

I didn't work with none, yeah. He played with Robichaud the whole time he was here. And let me see how he did that. Didn't he get off a bass on trombone or a trombone on bass or something? Yeah, that's right. Something like that, I remember.
He played trombone with P. Ron.
And he played bass in Chicago a lot. Yeah. Played bass with Jelly Roll.
And it seems to me he played bass down here with a band that Clarence Williams had in charge.
That was what Matthews did too. Matthews used to be a drummer. Bill Matthews.
How did he rate the drummers?
Well, he played with the tuxedos all the time. I never found out much about him.
